name: fl-studio-agent
description: Drive FL Studio from an AI agent with one Python tool: write notes, mix, render and listen.
long_description: Gives Claude one tool, run: Python bound to the live FL Studio session. It writes notes, sets tempo, levels and plugin parameters, checks which channels sound, renders the mix or single instruments to WAV, and analyses them with numpy, librosa and matplotlib. Before first use, close FL Studio and run `uvx --python 3.12 --from fl-studio-agent fl-mcp-install` once (on Windows from an administrator terminal): it installs the FL-side scripts and the prebuilt, checksum-verified Bridge plugin, the native FL effect the server requires to write notes and render. Setup guide: https://github.com/origami-research/fl-studio-agent#quick-start
